title: Meeting People and Small Talk
ringkas: Berkenalan, asal, pekerjaan, undangan, dan menolak sopan
goals: bertanya dan menjawab tentang **asal, pekerjaan, dan keluarga**

lesson.text: Obrolan ringan (small talk) adalah kunci berteman dan bekerja sama. Pelajari ungkapan berikut dan pola **Where are you from?**, **What do you do?**, dan **Would you like to ...?**

items.ex: Nice to meet you, I'm Rani.
How long have you been in London?
Is this your first time here?
What are you doing this weekend?
By the way, where did you learn English?
I'd like to invite you to dinner.
Would you like to join us?
I'm afraid I can't come on Friday.
Thank you so much for your help.
Take care and see you soon.

lines.en: Hi, I'm Dina. Nice to meet you.
lines.id: Hai, aku Dina. Senang bertemu denganmu.

lines.en: Nice to meet you, Dina. I'm Tom. Where are you from?
lines.id: Senang bertemu denganmu, Dina. Aku Tom. Kamu berasal dari mana?

lines.en: I'm from Indonesia. What do you do?
I'm a teacher. Would you like to join us for lunch?
lines.id: Aku guru. Maukah kamu bergabung makan siang?
Bagus. Sampai jumpa pukul dua belas.

lesson.title: Cara menghafal
lesson.text: Pola obrolan ringan: pertanyaan + tanggapan + pertanyaan balik. Contoh: *I'm from Bali. And you?* Pertanyaan balik membuat percakapan berlanjut.

items: Berkenalan: [[nice to meet you]], [[where are you from]], [[I'm from]], [[what do you do]], [[how long have you been]], [[first time]].
Undangan dan terima kasih: [[invite]], [[would you like to]], [[I'd love to]], [[I'm afraid I can't]], [[maybe next time]], [[thank you so much]].
